method: Manual pixel landmark annotations; x edges exclusive. Signed eye-to-beak vertical distance; pitch changes its sign. Skull excludes crest and goggle strap. Native rows provide pose comparison, not a claim that a fox or hedgehog has identical falcon anatomy. Slope annotations are in source-flat anatomical axes.
limits: Manual landmark placement has approximately one pixel uncertainty.
Native per-frame skull/torso rectangles have not been certified; reference rows are visual comparisons.
Existing approved FLY has 8-9px torso vs WAIT 9px; pitched/crouched/curled poses must not be judged on total silhouette height.
